surface: plate-pr-gates, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, release cut/finalize, gh plate release status
summary: While the standing Next Release issue has release-window:open, pr-gates blocks PRs whose base is a release integration branch unless release-window-override is applied; cut applies the label; finalize removes it from the next standing issue.
migration_impact: Regenerate or import plate-pr-gates.yml. Sync labels including release-window:open and release-window-override. Release cut (non-dry-run) applies release-window:open on the Next Release issue; finalize clears it when spawning the next standing issue.
agent_notes: gh plate release status reports release_window_open. Use release-window-override only for approver-sanctioned exceptions (#1439).
